title: Trace-Cone Classification after Razak–Jacelon Stabilization
exact_target: For separable nuclear $C^*$-algebras $A$ and $B$, does $T(A)\cong T(B)$ if and only if $A\otimes\mathcal W\otimes\mathcal K\cong B\otimes\mathcal W\otimes\mathcal K$, assuming the trace-cone isomorphism is a linear homeomorphism?
